parameters.query:
WITH time_ctx AS (
  SELECT public.is_daytime() AS is_day, public.current_shift() AS current_shift
), returning_lead AS (
  SELECT * FROM public.find_returning_lead($1, $2, $3) LIMIT 1
)
SELECT r.conversation_id AS existing_conv_id,
       r.assigned_agent_id,
       r.current_property AS existing_property,
       r.same_property,
       r.mode AS existing_mode,
       t.is_day,
       t.current_shift
FROM time_ctx AS t
LEFT JOIN returning_lead AS r ON TRUE;

UPDATE public.conversations
SET last_message_at = NOW(),
    property_public_id = COALESCE(property_public_id, NULLIF($2, ''))
WHERE conversation_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING conversation_id, assigned_agent_id, lead_name, property_public_id;
SELECT whatsapp_number FROM public.agents WHERE agent_id = $1;

INSERT INTO public.conversations (
  lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, mode, source,
  arrived_during, i24_lead_id, property_public_id
) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'pending_assignment', 'inmuebles24', 'day', $5, NULLIF($6, ''))
ON CONFLICT (i24_lead_id) WHERE i24_lead_id IS NOT NULL
DO UPDATE SET
  last_message_at = NOW(),
  property_public_id = COALESCE(conversations.property_public_id, EXCLUDED.property_public_id)
RETURNING conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property,
          i24_lead_id, property_public_id;

SELECT u.*, $1::uuid AS conversation_id, $2 AS property_id,
       $5 AS lead_phone, $6 AS lead_name, $4 AS lead_email,
       $7 AS property_title, $8 AS property_price, $9 AS property_public_id,
       $11 AS scraper_lead_id
FROM public.upsert_i24_lead_opportunity_recovering(
  $1::uuid, $2, NULL, $4, $5, 'inmuebles24', $11, 'captured'
) AS u;

SELECT s.*,
       $1::uuid AS conversation_id,
       $2::bigint AS opportunity_id,
       $3::text AS property_public_id
FROM public.get_routing_safe_mode() AS s;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Upsert Canonical Opportunity').item.json.conversation_id, $('Upsert Canonical Opportunity').item.json.opportunity_id, $('Upsert Canonical Opportunity').item.json.property_public_id || null] }}

parameters.query:
WITH manual AS (
  UPDATE public.i24_capture_events
  SET route_dispatch_status='manual_review',
      route_dispatch_last_error_code=$3,
      route_dispatch_lease_token=NULL,
      route_dispatch_lease_expires_at=NULL,
      route_dispatch_next_attempt_at=NULL
  WHERE capture_event_id=$2::bigint
    AND $3 IN ('property_public_id_required','easybroker_public_url_missing')
    AND route_dispatch_status IN ('pending','leased','failed')
  RETURNING capture_event_id, opportunity_id
), routed AS (
  SELECT to_jsonb(r) AS result
  FROM public.route_missing_owner_data($1::bigint,'missing_owner_data',$4) r
  WHERE $3 NOT IN ('property_public_id_required','easybroker_public_url_missing')
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('state','manual_review','capture_event_id',capture_event_id,'opportunity_id',opportunity_id,'reason',$3) AS result
FROM manual
UNION ALL
SELECT result FROM routed;

WITH conversation AS (
  INSERT INTO public.conversations (
    lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, mode, source,
    arrived_during, i24_lead_id, property_public_id
  ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'night_queued', 'inmuebles24', 'night', $5, NULLIF($6, ''))
  ON CONFLICT (i24_lead_id) WHERE i24_lead_id IS NOT NULL
  DO UPDATE SET
    last_message_at = NOW(),
    property_public_id = COALESCE(conversations.property_public_id, EXCLUDED.property_public_id)
  RETURNING conversation_id, lead_phone, lead_name, lead_email, current_property, property_public_id
)
SELECT conversation.*, u.opportunity_id, u.should_route, $4 AS property_id
FROM conversation
CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.upsert_i24_lead_opportunity_recovering(
  conversation.conversation_id, $4, NULL, $3, $7, 'inmuebles24', $5, 'queued_night'
) AS u;

WITH intake AS (SELECT * FROM public.v3_intake($1,$2,'inmuebles24',$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8::jsonb,NOW())) SELECT intake.*,$9::uuid AS conversation_id,$10 AS property_id,$11 AS property_title,$12 AS property_price,$13 AS lead_name,CASE WHEN intake.disposition='created_new' AND intake.contactado_status='verified' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS should_route,COALESCE($14::text[],ARRAY[]::text[]) AS property_tags FROM intake;

parameters.jsCode: const owner = $input.item.json; const lead = $('Restore V3 Dispatch Context').item.json; const easybrokerUrl = String(owner.easybroker_url || '').trim(); if (!/^https:\/\/(?:www\.)?easybroker\.com\//i.test(easybrokerUrl)) throw new Error('easybroker_public_url_required'); return [{ json: { conversation_id: lead.conversation_id, opportunity_id: lead.opportunity_id, capture_event_id: lead.capture_event_id, property_tags: owner.tags || [], property_id: lead.listing_id, property_public_id: owner.property_public_id || lead.property_public_id, property_title: owner.property_title || lead.property_title, operation_type: owner.operation_type || lead.operation_type || '', property_zone: owner.property_zone || lead.property_zone || '', property_price: owner.property_price || lead.property_price, easybroker_url: easybrokerUrl, lead_name: lead.name, lead_phone: lead.identity_phone, owner_agent_id: owner.owner_agent_id, owner_name: owner.owner_name, owner_number: owner.owner_number, routing_tier: 'owner' } }];

const normalized = $input.item.json; const webhook = $('Scraper Webhook').item.json; const body = webhook.body || webhook; const raw = Array.isArray(body) ? body[0] : body; const captureEventId = Number(raw.capture_event_id); const opportunityId = Number(raw.opportunity_id); if (!Number.isSafeInteger(captureEventId) || captureEventId <= 0) throw new Error('valid capture_event_id required'); if (!Number.isSafeInteger(opportunityId) || opportunityId <= 0) throw new Error('valid opportunity_id required'); return [{ json: { ...normalized, capture_event_id: captureEventId, opportunity_id: opportunityId, conversation_id: raw.conversation_id || null, disposition: raw.disposition || null, contactado_status: raw.contactado_status || null } }];

nodes.name: Created New V3?
nodes.notes: Only created_new may enter owner resolution/fallback. Duplicate and returning-assigned captures are handled by the V3 disposition RPC.

parameters.query: SELECT public.v3_route_ready_opportunity($1::bigint,$2::bigint,ARRAY[]::text[],NOW()) AS result;

nodes.name: Handle V3 Non-New Disposition
nodes.notes: active_duplicate becomes a durable no_action; returning_assigned enqueues one idempotent assigned notice. Neither can open a guard fallback.

parameters.query:
SELECT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM public.lead_routing_opportunities o
  JOIN public.i24_capture_events c
    ON c.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
  WHERE o.opportunity_id = $1::bigint
    AND c.capture_event_id = $2::bigint
    AND o.v3_enabled
    AND (
      (
        c.disposition = 'active_duplicate'
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.lead_routing_events dedup
          WHERE dedup.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
            AND dedup.event_type = 'deduplicated'
            AND dedup.metadata->>'capture_event_id' = c.capture_event_id::text
        )
      )
      OR (
        c.disposition = 'returning_assigned'
        AND o.assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL
        AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.lead_routing_delivery_attempts notice
          WHERE notice.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
            AND notice.capture_event_id = c.capture_event_id
            AND notice.delivery_kind = 'assigned_notice'
        )
      )
      OR (
        c.disposition = 'created_new'
        AND o.state IN (
          'delivery_requested','guard_delivery_pending','delivered',
          'owner_open','primary_guard_open','backup_guard_open',
          'assigned','unassigned_alerted','closed_won','closed_lost'
        )
        AND (
          o.assigned_agent_id IS NOT NULL
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.lead_routing_delivery_attempts a
            WHERE a.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
              AND a.capture_event_id = c.capture_event_id
              AND a.delivery_kind = 'offer'
              AND NULLIF(a.provider_message_id,'') IS NOT NULL
              AND a.provider_accepted_at IS NOT NULL
              AND a.bound_at IS NOT NULL
              AND a.status IN ('sent','delivered')
          )
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM public.lead_routing_events ev
            WHERE ev.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
              AND ev.event_type = 'missing_owner_data'
              AND ev.idempotency_key LIKE 'wf10:missing-owner:' || o.opportunity_id::text || ':%'
          )
        )
      )
    )
) AS accepted, $1::bigint AS opportunity_id, $2::bigint AS capture_event_id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Restore V3 Dispatch Context').first().json.opportunity_id, $('Restore V3 Dispatch Context').first().json.capture_event_id] }}

nodes.name: Verify V3 Dispatch Durable
nodes.notes: A 2xx for a created-new offer requires the exact capture to have a bound, provider-accepted WAMID in sent/delivered state; assignment and missing-owner outcomes remain separate durable exits.

nodes.name: Respond V3 Dispatch Accepted
nodes.notes: Acknowledge only after the database evidence gate accepts the exact capture/opportunity pair.

nodes.name: Respond V3 Dispatch Not Durable
nodes.notes: Explicit non-2xx keeps the route lease retryable when no durable downstream effect exists.
